Inside Runway Labs, where designers are prototyping what real-time video models make possible. This episode explores video as an operating system: selecting anything on a page to dive deeper with no prompting, videos you can resize where the model reinterprets what you see and a drawing app that animates your sketches in your own style as you draw. The point is to suspend disbelief, step into an idea and have it be a conversation.
